content.text:
## Scope

Everything you listed is part of the **combat playtest shell** (`CombatTest2`), not the nested slot root. Definitions come from:

- **Scene file:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`
- **Runtime layout / extra nodes:** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`

`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn` only defines grid/readout nodes under `CombatRoot`; it does **not** define items/history/EXECUTE/bankroll/stake for this shell.

---

### 1) Items rectangle / list

| | |
|---|---|
| **File** | `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd` (`_make_side_panel`, `_build_item_picker`) |
| **Not in .tscn** | No items panel node in `combat_test.tscn`. |
| **Runtime node path** | `CombatTest2/PlayArea/PlayRow/ItemPickerPanel` → inner: `VBoxContainer` → `ScrollContainer` → `VBoxContainer` (list of `CheckBox` rows) |

**Editable properties (code):**

- **Panel:** `PanelContainer` with `StyleBoxFlat` from `_side_panel_style()`: `bg_color` `(0.07, 0, 0, 0.88)`, `border_color` `(0.45, 0.03, 0.03, 0.75)`, border width **2**, corner radius **4**, content margins **8** all sides.
- **Column:** `VBoxContainer` `separation` **4**; `ScrollContainer` vertical expand, horizontal scroll **disabled**.
- **List:** inner `VBoxContainer` `separation` **4**; checkboxes use `SIDE_PANEL_BODY_FONT` (**16**), rarity `font_color` from `RARITY_COLORS`; empty state label uses `SIDE_PANEL_HINT_FONT` (**14**), `font_color` `(0.5, 0.3, 0.3, 0.8)`.
- **Sizing:** `_apply_responsive_layout()` sets `custom_minimum_size` to `Vector2(side_w, main_h)` (side width from layout math; height = main band height).

---

### 2) Execute button

| | |
|---|---|
| **File (base)** | `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn` |
| **File (behavior/size)** | `combat_test.gd` (`_build_play_shell`, `_layout_execute_button_width`, `_refresh_spin_button_state`) |

**Scene node (saved):** `CombatTest2/SpinButton` — `%SpinButton`

**After `_ready` (typical path):** `CombatTest2/PlayArea/PlayRow/CenterColumn/CenterFooter/SpinButton`

**.tscn properties:**

- `visible = false` (script sets `visible = true` after reparent).
- `custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 72)`
- `size_flags_horizontal` / `vertical` = **4** (expand in scene; script later uses shrink center + overrides width).
- **Theme overrides:** `font_size` **60**; `font_color` / `font_pressed_color` / `font_hover_color` / `font_disabled_color` (reds/blacks as in scene); **StyleBoxFlat** subs: `normal`, `pressed`, `hover`, `disabled` (red CRT-style borders, radii **8**, hover/normal shadow).
- `text = "EXECUTE"`

**Script overrides:**

- Reparent into `CenterFooter`; `custom_minimum_size.y` **≥ 72** (`EXECUTE_BUTTON_MIN_HEIGHT`); width set to **grid width** in `_layout_execute_button_width()`.
- Text toggles `"EXECUTE"` vs `"SPIN LOCKED"`; `z_index = 30`, `mouse_filter = STOP`.

---

### 3) Stake indicator (+/- and current bet)

| | |
|---|---|
| **File (structure)** | `combat_test.tscn` |
| **File (pill + layout)** | `combat_test.gd` (`_style_stake_pill`, `_integrate_stake_into_center_column`, `_refresh_readouts`) |

**Scene path (saved):** `CombatTest2/StakeSelector` (root child), inner `StakeSelector/BetRow` with `BetMinusButton`, `BetLabel`, `BetPlusButton` (unique names for `%` access).

**After `_ready` (typical):** `CombatTest2/PlayArea/PlayRow/CenterColumn/StakeSelector/BetRow/...`

**Bet value “indicator”:** `BetLabel` is moved under runtime `StakePill`:

- Path: `.../BetRow/StakePill/BetLabel`

**.tscn (StakeSelector / BetRow):**

- `StakeSelector`: `layout_mode` **0**, size `360×48`, `theme_override_constants/separation` **12**, `alignment` **1** (center).
- `BetRow`: `separation` **12**, `alignment` **1**.
- `BetMinusButton` / `BetPlusButton`: `custom_minimum_size` **40×40**, text `-` / `+`.
- `BetLabel`: `text = "1"`.

**Runtime (StakePill):**

- `StyleBoxFlat`: `bg_color` `(0.1, 0, 0, 0.85)`, `border_color` `(0.78, 0.03, 0.03, 0.95)`, border **2**, corner radius **18**, horizontal content margins **16**, vertical **4**; `BetLabel` `font_size` override **22**, centered; numeric text from `combat.get_current_bet()`.

---

### 4) Total bankroll label

| | |
|---|---|
| **File (base)** | `combat_test.tscn` |
| **File (reparent + text)** | `combat_test.gd` (`_organize_top_hud`, `_apply_responsive_layout`, `_refresh_readouts`) |

**Scene path (saved):** `CombatTest2/TopBar/BankrollLabel` — `%BankrollLabel`

**After `_ready`:** child of `CenterTopHud`: `CombatTest2/CenterTopHud/BankrollLabel`

**.tscn properties:**

- **Anchors:** centered on `TopBar` (`anchor_left/right/top/bottom = 0.5`), offsets about **240×48** centered (`offset_left -120`, etc.).
- `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size` **36**
- `text = "100/100"`, horizontal/vertical alignment **1** (center)

**Script:**

- `size_flags` shrink center; parent `CenterTopHud` gets anchor rect **0.40–0.60** × **0.03–0.125** (viewport fractions); `add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)` again in `_apply_responsive_layout`; text `"%d/%d"` from `get_bankroll()` / `get_bankroll_cap()`.

---

### 5) Spin history section / rectangle

| | |
|---|---|
| **File** | `combat_test.gd` (`_build_history_placeholder`, `_build_play_shell`, `_apply_responsive_layout`) |
| **Not in .tscn** | No dedicated history node in `combat_test.tscn`. |

**Runtime path:** `CombatTest2/PlayArea/PlayRow/HistoryPanel`

**Structure:** `VBoxContainer` named `HistoryPanel`:

- `HistoryHeader` (`Label`, text `"HISTORY"`, center, `font_size` **18** (`SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT`), `font_color` `(0.75, 0.35, 0.35, 0.95)`).
- `HistoryPlaceholder` (`Control`, expand fill) — **no** panel `StyleBox`; no background/border in code (acts as empty stretched area).

**Layout:**

- `size_flags_horizontal` **SHRINK_BEGIN** on panel; `custom_minimum_size` **same as items column**: `Vector2(side_w, main_h)` in `_apply_responsive_layout`.
- Root `VBoxContainer` `separation` **4**.

**Note:** `BudgetLabel` in the scene (`text = "SPIN LOG  0"`, bottom-left) is **hidden** in `_ready` — it is **not** the live history column.

---

### 6) History / items title labels

| | |
|---|---|
| **History title** | Created in `_build_history_placeholder()`: node `HistoryHeader` under `HistoryPanel` — properties above. |
| **Items title** | From `_make_side_panel()` header `Label`, exposed as `_item_picker_title`; initial scene string replaced in `_build_item_picker()` with `"ITEMS (count/max)"`. Styling: `font_size` **18**, `font_color` `(0.75, 0.35, 0.35, 0.95)`, horizontal alignment center (`SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT` also re-applied for items title). |

---

## Summary: .tscn vs runtime

| Element | In `combat_test.tscn`? | Heavily modified at runtime? |
|--------|-------------------------|------------------------------|
| Items panel + scroll list | No | Yes (full build) |
| EXECUTE (`SpinButton`) | Yes | Yes (reparent, width, text, visibility, z_index) |
| Stake row (`StakeSelector` / buttons / `BetLabel`) | Yes | Yes (reparent, `BetLabel` → `StakePill`, fonts, text) |
| Bankroll (`BankrollLabel`) | Yes | Yes (reparent, anchor rect via parent, font re-override, text) |
| History column | No | Yes (full build; no styled “rectangle”) |
| HISTORY / ITEMS titles | No | Yes (labels created in GDScript) |

If you need line-level references in the repo, the authoritative script blocks are ```393:433:C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd``` (`_make_side_panel`), ```350:374:...``` (`_build_history_placeholder`), ```754:787:...``` (`_build_item_picker`), and the bankroll/spin button nodes in ```191:208:C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn``` and ```294:310:...``` (`SpinButton`).
